blocks.x: Who would you use on piano when you did use them?
Well, the same color over the river. He played with me a lot, Mindy Minero.
I'll never forget one time when to play. You asked about it with a scene.

We were in the out of the, not the out of the field, but somewhere up in the corner. And when we got there, we went on piano. So, Mindy used to be like that all the time. And I showed him. So, he said, well, horse. I think he's kind of calling him horse. He said, well, what I'm going to do. He said, you just pet. Pet, you'll get your money. So, he pet. Wow. He said, man, my hand's old, so I can't play anymore. He asked about that. He had a pet all naked.
I never heard of that. He'll tell you, buddy.
Yeah, he said, it's a cornered engine inside. Oh.
Any other piano players you use? No.
